activities.name: resolve_laser_predict_inputs_activity

activities.purpose: Upsert each LaserPredictionResult. The gate fields are omitted, so a re-prediction clears the verdict (intended)

activities.name: backfill_laser_predictions_for_dive_activity
activities.purpose: Attach placeable predictions to existing incomplete, non-superseded LS tasks. Idempotent by the LS model_version tag laser-detector-v{N}. Then point each per-dive project's model_version at its majority tag

activities.name: select_next_high_priority_dive_for_laser_auto_accept_activity
activities.purpose: Auto-accept backlog cohort selector

activities.name: evaluate_laser_auto_accept_activity
activities.purpose: Fit the dive's WHOLE current prediction set and write per-frame verdicts (only rows that changed, 8 concurrent PUTs). If any prediction is stale, refuse the whole dive and clear standing verdicts. Returns LaserAutoAcceptSummary
touches: db:laserprediction read+write via SDK (GET /dives/{id}/laser-predictions/, PUT /images/{id}/laser-prediction/) -- the DATA-WORKER calls the API directly

activities.name: apply_laser_auto_accept_for_dive_activity
activities.purpose: Create an annotation (origin=prediction, ground_truth=False) on open tasks whose prediction has auto_accept, a dot, and an LS task that has no annotation and no draft. Does NOT write LaserLabel; the sync does that

activities.name: create_laser_label_studio_project_activity
activities.purpose: Idempotent per-dive project, found by title '{name} #{dive_id} - Laser Calibration Labeling' (50-char cap; the name is truncated, never the id). Heals the labeling config; registers Garage S3 source storage

activities.name: populate_laser_label_studio_project_activity
activities.purpose: Seed tasks for canonical images with a prediction and no completed label, gated on the JPEG existing in Garage. An auto-accepted prediction is imported as an annotation (with completed_by=bot_user_id); anything else is imported as a pre-annotation. The label colour is the dive-majority vote. Records sentinel-shaped rows (completed=False); publishes only when the import is complete

activities.name: select_dives_needing_laser_population_activity
activities.purpose: List every dive in the populate cohort

activities.name: preprocess_laser_image
activities.purpose: Download raw ORF; RectifiedImage(RawImage) (rawpy, undistort, CLAHE); draw a 2-px green polyline of the region (or a rectangle from bbox when region is None); JPEG-encode; PUT
touches: object-store: GET scratch raw/{checksum}.ORF; PUT labels {prefix}/preprocess_jpeg/{checksum}.JPG

activities.name: predict_laser_image
activities.purpose: LinearRawImage -> LaserDetector.predict(rectify_output=True). Read the colour at the dot after rectified_to_sensor_point. Drop x/y when the dot is outside the laser_region (rejected_out_of_region=True). Stamp predictor_version=2, checkpoint basename, core_version
touches: model: LaserDetector checkpoint /e4efs/models/run3_epoch_021.pt (env E4EFS_LASER_DETECTOR__CHECKPOINT; baked from HF ucsde4e/fishsense-laser-detector)
torch GPU if available, else CPU

activities.name: get_dives_with_complete_laser_labeling_activity
activities.purpose: Validation cohort: dives where every live laser label is completed

activities.name: validate_laser_labels_for_dive_activity
activities.purpose: Fetch labels including superseded ones plus the dive-slate calibration frames; run judge_dive once; upsert DiveLaserLine every run; on REFLECTION log an error and stand down; on GATE (>50%) refuse; supersede flagged rows that are still live (superseded is False) with superseded_reason validator_3sigma or validator_coarse_calibration; 8 concurrent PUTs

activities.name: plan_laser_supersede_remediation_activity
activities.purpose: One dive's DivePlan (read-only). Calls plan_dive, which calls judge_dive

activities.name: apply_laser_supersede_remediation_activity
activities.purpose: Re-plan from current state; refuse (non-retryable, nothing written) if any requested id is not in the fresh plan; revive the ones still superseded with superseded=False and reason=remediation; log REVIVED laser_label_id=...

api_endpoints.semantics: Lowest-id HIGH dive with a canonical image that has NO LaserLabel with label_studio_project_id IS NOT NULL (sentinels ignored; incomplete rows count as labeled), OR a canonical image carrying a label with needs_reprocess=TRUE AND superseded = FALSE (_has_image_flagged_for_reprocess :353). LIMIT 1.

HIGH AND (a canonical image with no LaserPrediction and no label that is completed=TRUE AND superseded=FALSE) OR (the dive is still being labeled: a canonical image with a completed=FALSE, superseded=FALSE, non-sentinel label AND a canonical image whose prediction's predictor_version IS DISTINCT FROM 2 and has no completed live label). Order by id, LIMIT 1.
All HIGH dives with a canonical image that HAS a LaserPrediction and has no completed=TRUE LaserLabel (superseded not filtered here). Returns a list ordered by id.

HIGH dive with a canonical image whose LaserPrediction has x,y NOT NULL AND gate_verdict IS NULL AND predictor_version = 2 (= excludes NULL). Abstentions are excluded so the cohort can drain. LIMIT 1.
Dive ids with at least one completed live (superseded=FALSE) label AND no live label whose completed is FALSE or NULL.

Distinct non-null project ids of live labels. incomplete => completed FALSE/NULL. gated=true => the project has a live-labelled image whose prediction has been judged AND none whose prediction's gate_verdict IS NULL; gated=false is the exact complement. The web landing page uses gated=true; the sync uses neither flag.

The dive's laser labels ORDER BY image_id, id (a total order the validator depends on). The default hides superseded = FALSE-mismatches, which also hides NULLs. 404 when empty (the SDK maps it to None/[]).

Natural-key upsert on (image_id, project_id), with an IS NULL branch for sentinels. Only fields present in the body are written. 409 when the id belongs to another image or when no project is given and the image has several rows. An unknown superseded_reason returns 422.
The sync's lookup. Filters superseded=FALSE, so corrections to a superseded task never sync back.

Raise: canonical, superseded=FALSE, and by default only completed FALSE/NULL rows. Clear: canonical rows, unfiltered by superseded or completed, optionally scoped to ?checksums (None clears the whole dive; [] clears nothing).
Upsert on image_id by whole-model merge (omitted gate fields reset to their defaults: auto_accept=False, gate_verdict=NULL). created_at is re-stamped server-side on every write.
Every prediction for the dive's images (canonical or not); an empty list, not a 404.
Upsert one DiveLaserLine per dive and stamp fitted_at; GET returns it or None.
Must mirror the cohorts above (test_dive_pipeline_status_view.py). Probably owned by the status-view slice.

In v1 the light-queue validator, auto-accept gate and remediation activities call fishsense-api through the SDK from the data-worker (D/activities/*: get_fs_client). v2 must move those reads/writes to orchestrator activities and pass rows through the contract

#927: each validator run is ONE judgement of the FULL population: fetch include_superseded, sort by (image_id, id) yourself (RANSAC picks pairs by row index), fit and flag once, and supersede only rows flagged AND still live. Re-fitting survivors eroded dives (dive 521 lost 15, then 7, then 1 on consecutive runs; 14,523 of 47,562 labels superseded). CLAUDE.md 'Laser-label validation'; test_laser_validator_does_not_erode.py

The validator never un-supersedes; revival is only the reviewed remediation tool. judge_dive is the single definition shared with remediation, so a revived label is one the next hourly run keeps (D/laser_label_validation/judgement.py)

judge_dive verdict order: TOO_FEW (<MIN_POINTS_FOR_LINE) -> NO_FIT -> REFLECTION (checked BEFORE confidence) -> NOT_CONFIDENT -> NO_OUTLIERS -> GATE (>50% flagged, MAX_OUTLIER_FRACTION) -> FLAGGED. Only NO_OUTLIERS and FLAGGED are 'judged'

Calibration frames (images with a completed, non-superseded dive-slate label) are judged at max(3 sigma, 20 px) via flag_outliers(calibration_mask=...), not at 3 sigma (dives 347/349). Slate labels are fetched BEFORE the fit so a transport failure fails the activity rather than falling back to the tight rule

A legacy superseded IS NULL row is fitted but never written (`is not False`). v2's migration maps NULL to False (bool(None) in v1_migration.py), so those rows become LIVE in v2, whereas every v1 resolver hid them. CLAUDE.md says prod has none carrying a dot, but verify

superseded_reason values: validator_3sigma, validator_coarse_calibration, manual (set it in EVERY hand-written UPDATE), remediation (on a live row: the last change was a revival). A plain string, not a native enum

Remediation apply takes dives, exclusions and digest ONLY from the reviewed dry-run report. The child re-plans and refuses on digest mismatch (non-retryable); the apply activity re-plans per dive and refuses the whole dive if any id is unplanned; ids already live are skipped; an empty plan is a clean no-op. It never revives reflection suspects, excluded ids, or non-completed labels

v1 sync looks labels up by LS task with superseded=FALSE, so a labeler's correction on a superseded task never reaches the DB. v2 apply_laser_sync updates by ls_task_id whether or not the row is superseded -- an intentional divergence? It changes what validation and remediation see. UNCERTAIN; confirm with the sync port

Auto-accept gate order: the dive gate fails closed first (min_predictions 20, then inlier_fraction >= 0.75 BEFORE line_confidence), then per frame perpendicular > 10 px -> off_line, along-line robust z > 4 -> along_line_outlier, then a deterministic blake2b(dive:image) audit sample at 10% (after the geometry tests). Detector confidence is deliberately unused

enabled=False is a dark run: verdicts are still computed and written but auto_accept=False, so gate_verdict='auto_accepted' can sit beside auto_accept=False. Everything downstream keys on the flag; the summary counts the flag

The gate refuses the WHOLE dive (stale_predictor) if ANY prediction's predictor_version != current, and clears standing auto_accept verdicts. The backlog cohort excludes the same rows (predictor_version = 2), while the predict cohort re-selects them via IS DISTINCT FROM
The gate writes only rows whose verdict changed (_changed compares margins at 1e-6). The backlog cohort therefore excludes abstentions (x/y NULL), or it would never drain

Gate timeouts: split queue-wait (schedule_to_start 20m) from execution (start_to_close 10m); schedule_to_close = the sum; both parents pass child exec 35m > 30m so the activity's own timeout fires. Sized to fit the already-deployed 1h run_timeout because ensure_schedule never updates in place (S/auto_accept_timeouts.py)
The predict parent and the drain share child id auto-accept-laser-{dive}. Both must handle CHILD_ALREADY_RUNNING (reading .eligible off the sentinel wedges the workflow task)

Replay contract: the predict parent appends persist -> cleanup_raw -> backfill -> gate -> apply in that order. Cleanup comes BEFORE the LS backfill so an LS outage cannot leak raw scratch (1,094 objects leaked once)
The predict parent must return BEFORE staging raw when the GPU queue is unavailable; a child on an unserved queue hangs until its 6h execution timeout instead of failing

dispatch_child returns CHILD_ALREADY_RUNNING and the caller must do NOTHING further (no cleanup_raw, no flag clear); prod dive 442 lost 984 raw objects and 515 flags that way (A/workflows/_dispatch.py:345-404)

Stage 0.1 flag clear is scoped to the redrawn checksums (a flag raised during the up-to-2h child survives). The no-work path clears the whole dive; the flag is the one cohort term that never goes false by itself (dive 60 blocked 84/465/471)
Resolvers must mirror their selector exactly, canonical images only, or a dive is re-selected hourly with no work, re-staging NAS raw and blocking every higher-id dive

The preprocess cohort is 'no NON-SENTINEL row' (label_studio_project_id IS NOT NULL), not 'no completed row'. The predict cohort keys on completed AND NOT superseded, NOT on project id, because populate seeds placeholder rows that carry a project id (dive 84 / project 274728)

Populate is prediction-gated (populating before predict would starve the predict cohort permanently; hence predict +10 / populate +12) and JPEG-gated (a missing preprocess_jpeg means a NoSuchKey task)

Populate never re-imports: tolerate invisible async LS imports and write rows for what is visible; publish only when ImportResult is complete; bounded retry (30s initial, 5 attempts) plus the IMPORT_ISSUED heartbeat marker. Duplicates split rows from annotations and bypass the auto-accept gate (dive 517). CLAUDE.md 'Populate must never re-import'

Auto-accepted frames are imported as an annotation with ground_truth=False explicitly (LS defaults it to true; dive 520) and completed_by=bot_user_id (imported annotations are otherwise attributed to the project owner), omitted when unconfigured. A task never carries both an annotation and a prediction
apply_laser_auto_accept touches a task only when LS reports no annotation AND no draft (idempotency, never overwrite a human, never discard work in progress); unknown tasks are skipped, not raised
Laser colour is a per-dive majority vote over prediction.color. A tie or no votes falls back to 'Red Laser'. Computed over ALL of the dive's predictions so top-up runs agree

Backfill idempotency keys on the LS model_version tag; attaching is not showing -- set the project's model_version to the majority tag, and only on per-dive projects (title contains #{dive_id}); never raises

LS project title '{name} #{dive_id} - Laser Calibration Labeling': names are not unique, so the #id is mandatory; truncate the name, never the id, to fit 50 chars; the lookup is scoped to the configured workspace; the labeling config self-heals

Predict: the detector's x/y are rectified pixels but LinearRawImage is in sensor coordinates, so convert with rectified_to_sensor_point before reading the colour (up to ~48 px off); the region test is on rectified x/y; a degenerate region admits nothing
predictor_version is bumped BY HAND whenever the stage output would change for an unchanged image; it versions behaviour, not the checkpoint
The detector is loaded once per process under a threading.Lock (double-checked); without it a cold pod loads N copies of the checkpoint onto the GPU
Stage 0.1 keeps both bbox and polygon for rolling-deploy skew; the bbox path must stay cv2.rectangle (notebook byte parity), not a 4-vertex polyline
Never write other renders into preprocess_jpeg (the lattice renders use their own prefix because checksum keys would overwrite the served laser JPEG)
LaserPrediction upsert deliberately merges the whole model (re-prediction clears verdicts); do NOT apply the label 'preserve unmentioned fields' fix to predictions (_upsert_label docstring)
The light queue exists because the per-image worker's max_concurrent_activities=2 is a memory ceiling; the validator, gate and remediation must not share it
The validation pass must wake the light worker only when there are complete dives, and suppress child failures so a successful sync is not rolled back; ALLOW_DUPLICATE ids
The DiveLaserLine is a WITHIN-dive fit; never use it as a prior for another dive or to choose a calibration borrow

Revival downstream needs a human for: refitting existing LaserExtrinsics, clearing a standing calibration refusal, redoing 6.1 groups, and images with two live laser labels (CLAUDE.md 'Reviving eroded labels')
Duplicate-code rule: keep laser-specific logic parameterised rather than copied per kind (the four put_*_label handlers were textual clones pylint could not see)
size: About 45 slice source files, ~4.8k lines (api-worker ~2.2k: 8 workflows + 13 activities + remediation CLI; data-worker ~2.2k: 5 workflows, 5 activities, laser_label_validation/{judgement,reflection,remediation,auto_accept}, laser_color; shared ~480: laser_region, auto_accept_timeouts, laser_predictor, laser_remediation). Plus ~600 lines of API endpoint code inside shared controllers (5 cohort endpoints, 6 label/prediction/reprocess endpoints, laser-line). Plus shared helpers the slice leans on (populate_utils 785, _dispatch ~350, gpu_fallback/k8s_scaling ~690) that other slices also own. Tests: 50 dedicated v1 test files, ~9.0k lines, 358 tests; plus 27 laser-cohort tests in test_select_next_dive_endpoints.py and 4 validation tests in test_sync_label_studio_laser_labels_workflow.py. Largest files: test_validate_laser_labels_for_dive_activity (19 tests / 653 lines), test_populate_laser_label_studio_project_activity (28/587), test_predict_laser_images_parent_workflow (11/415).
